"""Acceptance tests of F3 Priority. Written from the spec only; locked once approved."""

import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def todo(path, *args):
    """Run the CLI from the repository root: (exit code, stdout, stderr)."""
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "todo", "--file", path] + list(args), cwd=ROOT,
                       capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


def write(path, tasks):
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump({"tasks": tasks}, fh)


def read(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        return json.load(fh)


def task(i, text, done=False, priority=2):
    return {"id": i, "text": text, "done": done, "priority": priority}


class TestF3(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="todo-acc-")
        self.path = os.path.join(self.dir, "todo.json")

    def tearDown(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def add(self, *args):
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "add", *args)
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0, err)

    def test_c1_most_urgent_first(self):
        # trace: F3.C1 spec.md#L30-34
        self.add("a", "--priority", "3")
        self.add("b", "--priority", "1")
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "list", "--priority")
        self.assertEqual(rc, 0, err)
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ["2 [ ] b", "1 [ ] a"])

    def test_c2_default_priority_is_2(self):
        # trace: F3.C2 spec.md#L30-34
        self.add("low", "--priority", "3")
        self.add("plain")
        self.add("high", "--priority", "1")
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "list", "--priority")
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ["3 [ ] high", "2 [ ] plain", "1 [ ] low"])

    def test_c3_ties_keep_id_order(self):
        # trace: F3.C3 spec.md#L30-34
        self.add("x", "--priority", "2")
        self.add("y", "--priority", "1")
        self.add("z", "--priority", "2")
        rc, out, err = todo(self.path, "list", "--priority")
        self.assertEqual(out.splitlines(), ["2 [ ] y", "1 [ ] x", "3 [ ] z"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
